_meta.note: Auto-surface dep-lint at plan acceptance for CODE projects, so a user never has to remember to run it. Add a thin acceptance wrapper `deplint-accept` (node + python, a parity surface) that RESOLVES the codemap conditionally — explicit --codemap > <dir>/codemap.json > build a provisional one from <dir>/.codegraph/codegraph.db (edges via codegraph-map + fuzzy task->symbol via resolveTaskSymbols) > SKIP cleanly (non-code/un-indexed project) — then delegates to the existing `deplint` (advisory by default; --strict blocks). It stays advisory (report, never rewrites the DAG) and honest (an auto-built codemap uses the fuzzy matcher — 'confirm'). Wire it into the code-aware-planning skill's acceptance + the how-to so it runs automatically. Also closes a real parity gap: resolveTaskSymbols is node-only today — port it to python so the node-free path can auto-build too. Proof-driven: gated proofs for the codemap-present + skip cases and node ≡ python; a harness proof for the real CodeGraph db-build (skips without CodeGraph). Core stays domain-neutral — this lives in the code adapter + its skill, not in the base plan flow.

phases.title: deplint-accept wrapper — conditional codemap resolution + delegate (parity)

tasks.title: Spec-first: author the acceptance proofs (before impl)
tasks.description: Write the gated proofs RED first. (a) docs/howto/gate-examples/deplint-accept.sh (prints CODE-DEPLINT-ACCEPT-OK): in a temp dir with a codemap.json (copy plugin/adapters/code/fixtures/missing.codemap.json) + the fixture dag (missing.dag.json), `node plugin/adapters/code/deplint-accept.js --dir <d> --dag <dag>` prints the SAME deplint report (HB-CODE-DEPLINT + the MISSING line) and exits 0 (advisory); with --strict on that missing finding it exits nonzero; and in an EMPTY temp dir (no codemap.json, no .codegraph) it prints a DEPLINT-ACCEPT-SKIP line and exits 0. (b) docs/howto/gate-examples/deplint-accept-parity.sh (prints DEPLINT-ACCEPT-PARITY-OK): node ≡ python BYTE-identical for the codemap-present report AND the skip message; and resolveTaskSymbols/resolve_task_symbols agree on a fixture dag+nodes (pins the ported helper). Both proofs must FAIL now (no deplint-accept yet) — confirm red.

tasks.title: Implement the node wrapper + export deplint/formatReport
tasks.description: Refactor plugin/adapters/code/deplint.js to EXPORT `deplint` and a new `formatReport(r)` that returns the exact report string it already prints (extract the console.log lines; main prints formatReport(r) — output must stay byte-identical so T87/deplint-parity stay green). Write plugin/adapters/code/deplint-accept.js: CLI `--dir <d> --dag <dag> [--codemap <f>] [--strict]`. Resolve the codemap: explicit --codemap > <d>/codemap.json > (if <d>/.codegraph/codegraph.db exists) build a provisional codemap via readCodegraphDb+mapCodegraph (edges) and resolveTaskSymbols(dag,nodes) (tasks), prefixed with a one-line 'NOTE: provisional codemap (CodeGraph edges + fuzzy task→symbol) — confirm' > else print 'DEPLINT-ACCEPT-SKIP: no codemap or CodeGraph index in <d> (deplint skipped)' and exit 0. When a codemap is resolved, call deplint(dag,codemap), print formatReport(r), and exit (advisory 0; --strict → 1 iff missing or collision). Imports nothing from core. Make deplint-accept.sh pass.

tasks.title: Implement the python twin + port resolve_task_symbols
tasks.description: Add `format_report(r)` to py/src/heartbeat/adapters/code/deplint.py (same string; main prints it — byte-identical). Port `resolve_task_symbols(dag, nodes)` into py/src/heartbeat/adapters/code/codegraph_map.py mirroring the node fuzzy matcher EXACTLY (leaf-name substring of task title+description, lowercased) — closes the node-only parity gap. Write py/src/heartbeat/adapters/code/deplint_accept.py: same CLI + same resolution (explicit > <dir>/codemap.json > db-build > skip), same NOTE + SKIP strings, byte-identical report. Add py/tests cases (accept hit, skip, resolve_task_symbols). Make deplint-accept-parity.sh (node ≡ python) and tests/parity.sh green.
